# DrDebits - tax ethics and LLM guardrails

## Package overview
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ryanduguid/llm-tax-guardrails
- **Domain**: Versioned, primary-source-grounded ethical instructions and operational safety guardrails for LLM-assisted Australian accounting and taxation work.
- **Regulatory Frameworks**: *APES 110 Code of Ethics for Professional Accountants* (including Independence, Integrity, Objectivity, Professional Competence and Due Care, Confidentiality, and Professional Behaviour), *Tax Agent Services Act 2009 (TASA)* TPB Code of Professional Conduct.

## Policy specifications
1. **Source Grounding**: Statutory assertions are grounded per the guide's Source status and Authority and conflicts sections; source types carry different authority and the guide sets out which binds whom.
2. **Professional Demarcation**: AI agents assist with computational validation and initial synthesis; a competent, appropriately authorised human remains responsible for every professional service, judgement, and consequential action.

The guide (drdebits.md) is normative; this file is an index and routes into it.
